rules.name: unused-import
rules.detects: Imported name never referenced anywhere in the module
rules.fix: Remove the unused import (auto-fixable)

rules.name: redefined-while-unused
rules.detects: Name redefined before any use of the prior definition (duplicate import or function)
rules.fix: Drop or rename the first definition

rules.name: undefined-name
rules.detects: Reference to a name not defined in scope (typo or missing import)
rules.fix: Fix the name or add the missing import

rules.name: unused-variable
rules.detects: Local variable assigned but never read
rules.fix: Use the value, delete the assignment, or assign to _

rules.name: is-literal
rules.detects: is / is not compared against a string or number literal
rules.fix: Use == to compare constant literals

rules.name: f-string-missing-placeholders
rules.detects: f-string without any {} placeholders
rules.fix: Drop the f prefix

rules.name: none-comparison
rules.detects: == or != comparison against None
rules.fix: Use is None / is not None

rules.name: true-false-comparison
rules.detects: == True / == False equality comparison
rules.fix: Use the condition directly (if cond: / if not cond:)

rules.name: bare-except
rules.detects: except: with no exception type
rules.fix: Catch specific exceptions; widest legal is except Exception:

rules.name: invalid-escape-sequence
rules.detects: Invalid \x escape in a non-raw string literal
rules.fix: Use a raw string or correct the escape sequence

rules.name: bare-except-equivalent
rules.detects: Bare except equals except BaseException - swallows SystemExit/KeyboardInterrupt and typo'd NameErrors
rules.fix: Catch except Exception: and re-raise if needed

rules.name: hasattr-callable-check
rules.detects: hasattr(x,'__call__') as callable test - unreliable with custom __getattr__ or non-callable __call__
rules.fix: Use callable(x)

rules.name: strip-multi-char-arg
rules.detects: .strip() with multi-character arg strips a character SET, not substring ('text.txt'.strip('tx.') -> 'e')
rules.fix: Use .removeprefix() / .removesuffix() / .replace()

rules.name: mutable-argument-default
rules.detects: Mutable literal default ([], {}, set()) created once at def time and shared across calls
rules.fix: None sentinel; create the container inside

rules.name: function-call-in-default-argument
rules.detects: Call in argument default (def log(msg, ts=time.time())) frozen at def time; FastAPI Depends() exempt via extend-immutable-calls
rules.fix: Sentinel argument evaluated inside the function

rules.name: getattr-with-constant
rules.detects: getattr(obj,'name') with constant attribute name - no added safety, defeats static analysis and rename tooling
rules.fix: Direct attribute access: obj.name

rules.name: setattr-delattr-with-constant
rules.detects: setattr/delattr with constant attribute names - defeats static analysis and rename tooling
rules.fix: Set or delete the attribute directly

rules.name: assert-false
rules.detects: assert False - stripped entirely under python -O
rules.fix: Raise AssertionError() explicitly

rules.name: jump-in-finally
rules.detects: return/break/continue inside finally implicitly cancels the active exception and overrides try/except returns
rules.fix: Move flow control out of the finally block

rules.name: length-one-except-tuple
rules.detects: Length-one exception tuple: except (ValueError,)
rules.fix: Drop the tuple: except ValueError:

rules.name: redundant-exception-types
rules.detects: Redundant types in handler, e.g. except (Exception, TypeError):
rules.fix: Remove the redundant exception type

rules.name: useless-comparison
rules.detects: Comparison used as a statement (value == expected) with no effect
rules.fix: Delete it or make it side-effecting

rules.name: raise-literal
rules.detects: raise 'oops' raises a literal - raises TypeError instead of the intended exception
rules.fix: Raise an exception class or instance

rules.name: useless-expression
rules.detects: Side-effect-free expression statement, incl. trailing-comma tuples (print(x),)
rules.fix: Delete it or make it side-effecting

rules.name: cached-instance-method
rules.detects: functools.lru_cache/cache/alru_cache on instance methods - cache keys retain self, instances never GC'd (memory leak)
rules.fix: Move the cache off instance methods

rules.name: useless-contextlib-suppress
rules.detects: contextlib.suppress() with no arguments suppresses nothing
rules.fix: Pass an exception type or drop the suppress

rules.name: function-uses-loop-variable
rules.detects: Closure defined in a loop references the loop variable without binding - late binding reads at call time
rules.fix: Bind via default arg: lambda x, i=i:

rules.name: abstract-base-class-no-abstract-methods
rules.detects: ABC with no abstract methods - instantiation contract silently unenforced
rules.fix: Add @abstractmethod or drop the ABC

rules.name: duplicate-except-handler
rules.detects: Duplicate exception handlers across clauses - later ones unreachable
rules.fix: Remove the duplicate handler

rules.name: empty-stub-missing-abstractmethod
rules.detects: Empty concrete-looking stub method in ABC missing @abstractmethod - contract silently unenforced
rules.fix: Decorate with @abstractmethod

rules.name: except-empty-tuple
rules.detects: except () catches nothing - exceptions escape despite the handler
rules.fix: List real exception types

rules.name: groupby-reuse
rules.detects: itertools.groupby result or sub-iterator reused/consumed twice - second pass silently yields empties
rules.fix: Materialize groups fresh (dict/sorted)

rules.name: raise-without-from-inside-except
rules.detects: raise inside except lacking from err / from None - chained context lost
rules.fix: Raise RuntimeError(...) from exc, or from None

rules.name: zip-without-explicit-strict
rules.detects: zip() without explicit strict= - silent truncation risk on unequal lengths
rules.fix: Pass strict=True/False explicitly

rules.name: loop-iteration-mutation
rules.detects: Mutation of loop iterable while iterating (for x in items: items.remove(x)) - elements skipped (opinionated)
rules.fix: Iterate a copy or build a new list

rules.name: blind-except
rules.detects: Blind except Exception: that swallows any error with no re-raise or logging intent
rules.fix: Narrow the exception type, log, or re-raise (opinionated)

rules.name: except-baseexception-without-reraise
rules.detects: except BaseException: without re-raising - catches SystemExit/KeyboardInterrupt
rules.fix: Use except Exception: or re-raise

rules.name: mutable-class-attribute-shared
rules.detects: Mutable class attribute mutated via self - shared across all instances via instance->class lookup chain (tutorial Dog tricks example calls it mistaken use of a class variable)
rules.fix: Initialize per-instance state in __init__ (self.tricks = [])

rules.name: star-replication-aliasing
rules.detects: [[None]*2]*3 replicates references, not copies - rows are one shared object; writing one writes all
rules.fix: Build independent inner containers per element via comprehension

rules.name: tuple-augassign-mutates-despite-error
rules.detects: a_tuple[0] += x desugars get -> iadd (mutates in place) -> setitem (TypeError) - element changed despite the exception
rules.fix: Avoid augmented assignment on tuple-held mutables; mutate explicitly

rules.name: assignment-localizes-name
rules.detects: Any assignment anywhere makes the name local for the whole scope - earlier reads raise UnboundLocalError beyond F821's reach in complex flows
rules.fix: Declare nonlocal/global deliberately or rename to stop shadowing

rules.name: bool-subclasses-int
rules.detects: isinstance(True, int) is True - numeric isinstance checks accept booleans (sum([True,True]) == 2)
rules.fix: Exclude bool explicitly when strict int intended

rules.name: mutator-return-none-chaining
rules.detects: In-place methods like list.sort() return None by convention - result = y.sort() propagates None downstream
rules.fix: Do not assign results of mutating calls; use sorted() or copies when chaining

rules.name: str-plus-equals-quadratic
rules.detects: s += part accumulation on immutable str reallocates each concatenation - quadratic total cost; CPython in-place optimization non-portable
rules.fix: Collect parts into a list and ''.join(parts)

rules.name: long-elif-chain-dict-dispatch
rules.detects: Long if/elif chains - O(n) branching, extension-hard, fall-through-prone; dict-of-functions is flat and data-driven (primary case-construct emulation)
rules.fix: Replace with dict dispatch mapping command keys to handler functions

rules.name: hasattr-callable-variants
rules.detects: Callable probes beyond B004's exact form - custom __getattr__ or non-callable __call__ give false positives (PARTIAL lint coverage)
rules.fix: Prefer callable(x)

rules.name: groupby-subiterator-exhaustion
rules.detects: Consuming grouped groupby output twice silently yields empties - variants outside B031's flagged pattern (iterator-protocol behavior, not syntax)
rules.fix: Materialize groups before reuse

rules.name: non-trivial-property
rules.detects: Property with side effects, raising, or surprise - properties must stay cheap/straightforward/surprise-free; hand-rolled descriptors are the power feature
rules.fix: Keep properties trivial; convert to explicit method otherwise

rules.name: builtin-type-atomicity-reliance
rules.detects: Relying on builtin-type atomicity or bare assignment as thread synchronization
rules.fix: Guard shared state with locks or use Queue

rules.name: power-features-in-app-code
rules.detects: Metaclasses, bytecode access, exec, monkey-patching, dynamic inheritance, import hacks, __del__ cleanup in app code (stdlib-internal use is OK)
rules.fix: Avoid unless clearly justified

rules.name: unnecessary-generator-list
rules.detects: Generator inside list call: list(x for x in y)
rules.fix: Rewrite as a list comprehension

rules.name: unnecessary-collection-call
rules.detects: dict()/tuple()/list() called with no or literal args
rules.fix: Use {} / () / [] literals

rules.name: unnecessary-double-cast-or-process
rules.detects: Nested redundant casts/processes: list(set(x)), sorted(list(x))
rules.fix: Drop the inner redundant call: set(x)

rules.name: unnecessary-map
rules.detects: map(lambda ...) usage
rules.fix: Rewrite as a comprehension/listcomp

rules.name: collapsible-if
rules.detects: Nested if containing a single inner if
rules.fix: Combine into: if a and b:

rules.name: suppressible-exception
rules.detects: try/except X: pass pattern
rules.fix: Use contextlib.suppress(X)

rules.name: if-else-block-instead-of-if-exp
rules.detects: Variable assigned in both branches of an if/else
rules.fix: Use a ternary (suppressed when the line would exceed max length; opinionated, coverage-tooling caveat)

rules.name: multiple-with-statements
rules.detects: Nested with blocks
rules.fix: Combine into a single with statement (with open(a) as f, lock:)

rules.name: in-dict-keys
rules.detects: k in d.keys()
rules.fix: Use k in d

rules.name: unnecessary-return-none
rules.detects: Explicit return None when it is the only return path (only default-enabled RET rule)
rules.fix: Use a bare return

rules.name: unnecessary-assign
rules.detects: Local assigned then immediately returned by name
rules.fix: Return the expression directly

rules.name: superfluous-else-return
rules.detects: else: after a branch that returns
rules.fix: Dedent the else body

rules.name: manual-list-comprehension
rules.detects: For-loop appending transformed items one by one
rules.fix: Rewrite as out=[f(x) for x in xs]

rules.name: manual-list-copy
rules.detects: For-loop copying items one by one
rules.fix: Use list(src) / src.copy()

rules.name: try-except-in-loop
rules.detects: try/except wrapping the loop body
rules.fix: Hoist try/except outside the loop (speed)

rules.name: unnecessary-placeholder
rules.detects: Redundant pass / ... placeholder alongside other statements
rules.fix: Delete the placeholder

rules.name: duplicate-class-field-definition
rules.detects: Class field defined twice - second silently wins
rules.fix: Remove the duplicate definition

rules.name: lambda-assignment
rules.detects: Lambda bound to a name (f = lambda ...)
rules.fix: Use a def statement

rules.name: magic-value-comparison
rules.detects: Comparison against unnamed magic constant
rules.fix: Extract to a named constant

rules.name: non-pep585-annotation
rules.detects: typing.List[int]-style generics instead of builtin generics
rules.fix: list[int]; target >=3.9 or __future__ annotations; unsafe pre-3.9 with runtime annotation consumers (Pydantic); keep-runtime-typing opt-out

rules.name: non-pep604-annotation-union
rules.detects: Union[int, str] instead of PEP 604 union (Optional[X] handled by sibling UP045)
rules.fix: int | str; target >=3.10 or future-annotations; unsafe pre-3.10; same keep-runtime-typing escape hatch

rules.name: super-call-with-parameters
rules.detects: super(B, self).foo() with explicit parameters
rules.fix: super().foo(); rewrite valid iff arg1 is __class__ and arg2 is the enclosing method's first arg; unsafe fix (comment loss)

rules.name: redundant-open-modes
rules.detects: open(f, 'r') redundant open mode
rules.fix: open(f); safe autofix

rules.name: os-error-alias
rules.detects: IOError / EnvironmentError aliases
rules.fix: Use canonical OSError

rules.name: printf-string-formatting
rules.detects: %-style formatting '%s, %s' % (a, b)
rules.fix: .format() or f-string; ambiguous '%s' % val gets no safe fix (tuple-vs-scalar semantics differ)

rules.name: f-string
rules.detects: '{}'.format(x) instead of an f-string
rules.fix: Convert to f-string; skips cases with unpacking/format-specifier edge cases

rules.name: non-pep695-type-alias
rules.detects: Assignment-style or TypeAlias-annotated type alias
rules.fix: PEP 695 type X = ...; target-version gated (PEP 695 = 3.12+)

rules.name: replace-str-enum
rules.detects: class Foo(str, enum.Enum)
rules.fix: class Foo(enum.StrEnum); target >=3.11; deliberate behavior choice - restores 3.10-style str(Foo.BAR) formatting broken by 3.11 change

rules.name: yield-from-delegation
rules.detects: for x in y: yield x manual delegation
rules.fix: yield from y (delegation clarity/perf)

rules.name: py39-stdlib-niceties
rules.detects: startswith-slice trimming; functools.lru_cache(maxsize=None); ' '.join(shlex.quote(a) for a in cmd)
rules.fix: x.removeprefix(y); @functools.cache; shlex.join(cmd); --py39-plus / target >=3.9

rules.name: subprocess-run-modern-kwargs
rules.detects: universal_newlines=True; separate stdout=PIPE, stderr=PIPE pairs
rules.fix: text=True; capture_output=True; --py37-plus / target >=3.7

rules.name: datetime-utc-shorthand
rules.detects: datetime.timezone.utc references
rules.fix: datetime.UTC; --py311-plus / target >=3.11

rules.name: call-datetime-utcnow
rules.detects: datetime.datetime.utcnow() returns a naive datetime - cannot be compared or located unambiguously
rules.fix: datetime.datetime.now(tz=datetime.timezone.utc), or tz=datetime.UTC on 3.11+

rules.name: dead-py2-shims
rules.detects: six.text_type/six.iteritems/six.with_metaclass; from mock import patch; obsolete __future__ imports
rules.fix: str; dct.items(); class C(B, metaclass=M); unittest.mock.patch; drop shims once target >=3.x (--keep-mock opt-out exists)

rules.name: version-gated-dead-blocks
rules.detects: if sys.version_info < (3, 6): ... else: ... compat blocks; satisfied pytest skipif markers
rules.fix: Keep only the satisfied branch body; if-without-else left alone (syntax-error risk)

rules.name: naming-case-conventions
rules.detects: Classes not CapWords, functions/modules not snake_case, constants not ALL_CAPS, wrong self/cls first argument, or l/O/I single-char names
rules.fix: Apply PEP 8 naming conventions

rules.name: underscore-semantics
rules.detects: _leading weak-internal vs __double_leading mangled misuse; invented __dunder__ names
rules.fix: Single underscore for internals; never invent __dunder__ names

rules.name: imports-one-per-line
rules.detects: import os, sys on one line (from-import lists exempt)
rules.fix: One import per line

rules.name: import-group-order
rules.detects: Imports not ordered stdlib -> third-party -> local with blank-line separation, after docstring/globals
rules.fix: Regroup imports per PEP 8

rules.name: absolute-imports-preferred
rules.detects: Relative import where absolute is preferred
rules.fix: Use absolute imports; explicit relative acceptable sparingly

rules.name: wildcard-import-ban
rules.detects: from x import * usage (sole exception: republishing an internal API)
rules.fix: Import names explicitly

rules.name: module-dunder-placement
rules.detects: __all__/__version__ placed after imports instead of after docstring and before imports
rules.fix: Place module dunders after the docstring, before imports (except from __future__)

rules.name: top-level-blank-lines
rules.detects: Missing two blank lines around top-level defs/classes; wrong method spacing
rules.fix: Two blank lines around top-level definitions; one between methods

rules.name: keyword-default-spacing
rules.detects: Spaces around = in kwargs/unannotated defaults, or missing spaces when annotated default
rules.fix: No spaces unannotated; spaces around = only with annotated default

rules.name: none-singleton-comparison
rules.detects: None compared with ==/!=; not x is None ordering; truthiness used where a None-check was intended
rules.fix: Always is/is not None; beware falsy values when checking None

rules.name: return-consistency
rules.detects: Function mixes value-returning and bare returns
rules.fix: All returns return an expression, or none do (explicit return None otherwise)

rules.name: exceptions-from-Exception-error-suffix
rules.detects: Exception derived directly from BaseException; error exception without *Error name
rules.fix: Derive from Exception; name error classes *Error

rules.name: bare-except-ban-minimal-try
rules.detects: Bare/all-catching handler without re-raise; oversized try clause
rules.fix: Catch specific exceptions (widest legal: except Exception:); keep the try clause minimal

rules.name: startswith-endswith-over-slicing
rules.detects: Prefix/suffix checks via slicing (foo[:n]=='bar')
rules.fix: Use .startswith() / .endswith()

rules.name: isinstance-not-type-compare
rules.detects: Type identity comparison: type(obj) is type(1)
rules.fix: Use isinstance(obj, int)

rules.name: bool-empty-seq-truthiness
rules.detects: == True/False comparisons or if len(seq):
rules.fix: Use if seq: / if not seq:

rules.name: trailing-commas
rules.detects: Missing singleton-tuple comma; commas on same line as closer; one-per-line collections lacking trailing comma
rules.fix: Mandatory in singleton tuples; encouraged for VCS-diffed collections

rules.name: lint-run-required
rules.detects: Linter not enforced in CI; suppressions not in searchable symbolic form
rules.fix: Enforce linter runs in CI; keep suppressions symbolic/searchable

rules.name: imports-modules-only-no-relative
rules.detects: Importing symbols/objects rather than packages/modules (typing/abc exempt); relative imports
rules.fix: Import packages/modules only; no relative imports

rules.name: assert-not-for-preconditions
rules.detects: assert used for validation/control flow - removable under python -O without breakage
rules.fix: Raise proper exceptions for validation; pytest asserts exempt

rules.name: custom-exception-rules
rules.detects: New exception not inheriting an existing one; missing Error suffix; prefix repetition (foo.FooError)
rules.fix: Inherit an existing exception; use *Error suffix; avoid repetition

rules.name: catch-all-ban
rules.detects: except Exception: not followed by re-raise and not a deliberate isolation point
rules.fix: Re-raise or narrow the caught exceptions

rules.name: avoid-mutable-global-state
rules.detects: Mutable module-level global state (ALL_CAPS module-level constants are fine)
rules.fix: Module-level constants only; _-prefixed internal mutable state if unavoidable

rules.name: mutable-default-args
rules.detects: Mutable or call defaults ([], {}, time.time()) in function signatures
rules.fix: None sentinel plus in-body creation/rebind

rules.name: true-false-evaluation
rules.detects: == False checks; missing is None for None tests; len()-truthiness; x or [] falsy conflation
rules.fix: is None always; never == False; truthiness for empty-sequence checks

rules.name: type-annotate-public-api
rules.detects: Public API added or modified without type annotations
rules.fix: Annotate public APIs; enable static checking in the build

rules.name: todo-comment-format
rules.detects: TODO comments without link/explanation; owner-only parenthesized style discouraged
rules.fix: Format: TODO: link - explanation

rules.name: main-guard-required
rules.detects: Executable script logic not behind main() with if __name__ == '__main__': guard
rules.fix: Put logic in main() guarded by the __main__ check

rules.name: dunder-discouraged
rules.detects: __mangled attribute access hurting readability/testability (not private); filenames not .py or containing dashes
rules.fix: Prefer _single underscore; .py filenames without dashes

rules.name: logging-lazy-percent-format
rules.detects: Logger calls using f-strings or pre-interpolated message strings
rules.fix: Logger takes literal %-format template plus args (lazy formatting)

rules.name: docstring-coverage-public-api
rules.detects: Public modules, exported functions/classes, public methods incl. __init__ lack docstrings
rules.fix: Add docstrings to all public surfaces

rules.name: triple-double-quotes-always
rules.detects: Docstring quote style not triple-double-quotes; missing r-prefix when backslashes present
rules.fix: Triple double quotes everywhere; r-prefix when backslashes present

rules.name: one-liner-imperative-no-signature
rules.detects: One-liner not an imperative phrase ending in period ('Returns the...' vs 'Return the...'); restates the signature
rules.fix: Command mood, end with period, never restate signature

rules.name: multiline-summary-blank-close
rules.detects: Multi-line docstring missing blank line after summary, or closing quotes inline
rules.fix: Summary line + blank + body; closing quotes on own line unless one-liner

rules.name: docstring-presence-codes
rules.detects: Missing docstrings on module/package/class/public function/method/magic method/__init__ (public = in __all__ or no _ prefix)
rules.fix: Add the missing docstring

rules.name: fits-on-one-line
rules.detects: One-liner docstring spans multiple physical lines
rules.fix: Fit it on one line with quotes

rules.name: summary-description-blank-line
rules.detects: Not exactly one blank line between summary and description
rules.fix: Insert a single blank line

rules.name: closing-quotes-own-line
rules.detects: Multi-line docstring closing quotes not on their own line
rules.fix: Move closing quotes to a separate line

rules.name: triple-double-quote-style
rules.detects: Docstring delimited by single-quote triples instead of double-quote triples
rules.fix: Use double-quote triples (single-quote style only when body contains them)

rules.name: first-line-ends-period
rules.detects: Docstring first line lacks terminating period
rules.fix: End the first line with '.'

rules.name: first-line-terminal-punctuation
rules.detects: Docstring first line lacks terminal punctuation (.!? )
rules.fix: End first line with '.', '?' or '!'

rules.name: imperative-mood-first-line
rules.detects: Docstring first line not imperative mood ('Does'/'Returns' vs 'Do'/'Return'); skipped for tests and @property
rules.fix: Use imperative mood

rules.name: pytest-unittest-assertion
rules.detects: unittest-style self.assert* calls inside pytest tests
rules.fix: Use plain assert statements

rules.name: pytest-raises-too-broad
rules.detects: pytest.raises(Exception) overly broad - test stays green even if tested code never ran
rules.fix: Narrow the exception type; add match=

rules.name: pytest-raises-with-multiple-statements
rules.detects: Multiple statements inside pytest.raises() block - masks which statement raised
rules.fix: Keep a single statement in the raises block

rules.name: assert-raises-exception
rules.detects: assertRaises(Exception)/BaseException and broad pytest.raises contexts ('should be considered evil'; exempt with match= / as ex); B908 flags multi-statement raises blocks
rules.fix: Assert specific exception types; add match=

rules.name: test-assertion-usefulness
rules.detects: Does the test fail when the code breaks? Will it false-positive when code changes beneath it? Vacuous-green beyond broad-except codes
rules.fix: Strengthen assertions; verify the test exercises the behavior (tests do not test themselves)

rules.name: test-fixture-hygiene
rules.detects: Fixture scope/isolation mistakes, shared-state leakage across tests, fixtures hiding coupling
rules.fix: Right-size fixture scopes; decouple hidden shared state

rules.name: mccabe-too-complex
rules.detects: Function cyclomatic complexity above --max-complexity threshold (inclusive since mccabe 0.3); plugin disabled by default; 'anything that goes beyond 10 is too complex'
rules.fix: Refactor into smaller functions; per-def noqa: C901 to suppress

rules.name: too-many-arguments
rules.detects: Function arguments exceed max-args threshold (shipped default widely cited as 5 - unconfirmed)
rules.fix: Group parameters into a config object; shrink signature surface

rules.name: too-many-branches
rules.detects: Branch count above max-branches (docs example config sets 10; shipped default cited as 12 - unconfirmed)
rules.fix: Split the function; canonical fix is elif-chain -> dict dispatch

rules.name: too-many-statements
rules.detects: Statement count above max-statements (docs example sets 7; shipped default cited as 50 - unconfirmed)
rules.fix: Split into smaller functions

rules.name: radon-cc-and-maintainability-index
rules.detects: CC = decisions + 1 (+1 per if/elif/for/while/except/with/assert/comprehension/boolean-op; else/finally +0); MI combines Halstead V, CC, SLOC, comment-% - radon's own docs call MI experimental
rules.fix: Weigh CC over experimental MI; treat both as proxies the reviewer's judgment completes

rules.name: vulture-confidence-tiered-dead-code
rules.detects: AST defined-vs-used dead-code walk, scope-insensitive: arguments/unreachable 100%, imports 90%, attribute/class/function/method/property/variable 60%
rules.fix: Gate CI with --min-confidence (100 = guaranteed-dead only); whitelist files preferred over noqa

rules.name: commented-out-code
rules.detects: Comments containing Python code - commented-out code is dead code; known false-positive class where prose resembles code (#4845)
rules.fix: Delete it; rely on VCS history; tune lint.task-tags as needed
